title: Sequential Extraction and Immunoblotting
author: Isabel Lam
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bu2wnyfe
materials: Dilute the primary antibodies in TBS/5% (wt/vol) milk and incubate them Overnight at 4 °C with shaking.

steps.title: Initial Neuron Rinse
steps.instruction: Rinse the neurons twice with PBS.

steps.title: First TX-100 Extraction
steps.instruction: Place the dish on ice. Working one well at a time, aspirate PBS and add ice-cold 1% (vol/vol) TX-100/TBS containing protease and phosphatase inhibitors.

substeps.instruction: Add 250 µL per well for a six-well plate
Add 500 µL for a 6-cm dish

steps.title: Cell Collection and Lysis
steps.instruction: Collect neurons and prepare for centrifugation.

substeps.instruction: Use a cell scraper to thoroughly scrape all neurons from each well
Transfer neurons into a polyallomar tube for a table top ultracentrifuge and keep on ice
Sonicate the tube ten times at a 0.5-s pulse and 10% power
Incubate the tube on ice for 00:30:00

steps.title: First Ultracentrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tube at 100,000 x g at 4 °C for 00:30:00.

steps.title: TX-100 Supernatant Processing
steps.instruction: Process the TX-100 supernatant and preserve the pellet.

substeps.instruction: Save ~20 µL of supernatant for protein assay
Add 4× Laemmli buffer to ~150 µL – 200 µL of TX-100 supernatant
Retain remaining supernatant on ice or in a -20 °C freezer

steps.title: Second TX-100 Extraction
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in ice-cold 1% (vol/vol) TX-100/TBS with protease and phosphatase inhibitors.

substeps.instruction: Add 250 µL per well for a six-well plate or 500 µL for a 6 cm dish
Sonicate ten times at a 0.5-s pulse and 10% power (keep probe tip toward bottom to prevent frothing; ensure pellet is completely dispersed)
Centrifuge the mixture at 100,000 x g at 4 °C for 00:30:00

steps.title: SDS Extraction
steps.instruction: Extract remaining proteins from the pellet using 2% (wt/vol) SDS/TBS with protease and phosphatase inhibitors.

substeps.instruction: Add 125 µL per well for a six-well plate or 250 µL for a 6 cm dish
Sonicate 15 times at a 0.5-s pulse and 10% power (keep probe tip toward bottom; ensure pellet is completely dispersed)
Remove the supernatant and transfer it into a new microcentrifuge tube

steps.title: Protein Quantification
steps.instruction: Perform a BCA/protein assay on the TX-100 supernatant and SDS extract, typically using a 1:5 dilution.

steps.title: Sample Preparation for Loading
steps.instruction: Dilute the 2% (wt/vol) SDS extract into Laemmli buffer to 2× volume for the corresponding TX-100 fraction.

substeps.instruction: Example: For 180 µL TX-100 extract (1 mg/mL) and 90 µL SDS extract, add 60 µL 4× Laemmli buffer to TX-100 and 30 µL 4× Laemmli buffer to SDS extract
Load 12.5 µL of both the TX-100 extract (10 g) and SDS extract

steps.title: Gel Electrophoresis
steps.instruction: Load samples on a 4–20% (wt/vol) gel and run at 85 V constant voltage until the dye front runs off the gel, ensuring the 10-kDa marker does not run off.

steps.title: Protein Transfer
steps.instruction: Transfer proteins to a nitrocellulose membrane using one of two settings: 100 V for 01:15:00 or Overnight at 40 V.

substeps.instruction: Block for 01:00:00 with TBS/5% (wt/vol) milk
Rinse three times with TBS/T, 00:10:00 per rinse

steps.title: Antibody Incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the membrane with HRP-conjugated secondary antibodies for 01:00:00 at room temperature.

substeps.instruction: Rinse the membrane three times with TBS/T, 00:10:00 per rinse

steps.title: Equipment Maintenance
steps.instruction: Clean the sonication tip after contact with PFFs by wiping with 1% SDS, followed by 70% ethanol.
